Team —

We're on a tight cadence for the QBR next week. To keep the exec readout tight, I want a short, uniform rollup for each top-20 live account: one-paragraph status (current ARR/commit, MRR trend, forecast this quarter), top 1-2 risks with mitigation, and a single recommended ask for the execs (e.g., approve discount, allocate SE time, escalate procurement).

Please use the attached compact template (two tabbed sheets: account-summary + forecast-cleanse) and return a completed sheet for each account you own by EOD Friday (2026-12-11). We will run a 30-min alignment on Monday morning (12/13) to consolidate the forecast changes.

Specific asks:
- Fill the blue cells only (summary + forecast delta).
- Flag whether a customer is in procurement or legal (Proc/Legal).
- Mark deals likely to slip more than one week as RED.

I'm also attaching the pipeline heatmap snapshot for context. Laura — can you run a quick sanity check on the forecast math before Monday? Karthik — please prioritize Acme and AtlasBank rollups; Marissa, take Nimbus Health and the three healthcare pilots.

Thanks — short and crisp here. If you need to hand this off to CS or Finance, loop them in but keep owners the same.

—Marcus
